decisions.reason: The anamnesis and consent app is the flagship product line and sits close to the firm's core dental practice software, so the firm can read its results and improve it through its own R&D, which makes it worth keeping.
The education institute uses the firm's existing training content and practitioner knowledge and supports customer loyalty, so it fits within the firm's absorptive base.
Remote screen sharing support is closely tied to the firm's customer support operations and is low-cost and easy to integrate, so keeping it is sensible.

The analytics dashboard draws on data from the firm's own software and matches its direction toward digital, efficiently managed practices, so the firm can assimilate the feedback and develop it further.
The complete practice bundle packages the firm's core offerings for new and larger practices, sits close to existing know-how, and supports sales.

The job and practice listing portal is distant from the firm's software expertise, which limits its ability to learn from and improve it, but it is cheap to run and helps engage the dental community, so the firm keeps it for now with an elevated risk of dropping it.
